contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [---]VS AVG ; R/ [VICTORIAE DD AVGGQ NN]

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Constantius II (323-361), Two Victories issue of 347-348, cf. RIC volume 8 no. 180, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Bust draped right, large eye. Obverse inscription: [---]VS AVG. Reverse description: Two Victories facing each other holding wreaths, M between figures. Reverse inscription: [VICTORIAE DD AVGGQ NN]. In exergue: [?T]RS. Cliff Reeves kindly examined…
